thread:
maria: Morning — dropping a rough PRD outline for fallback heuristics to prioritize for Q3. Need alignment on scope vs. M1 launch.

dan: can you paste the outline? quick bullets ok.

maria: sure — top-level goals: 1) avoid 5xx due to incompatible variants, 2) preserve latency SLOs where possible, 3) predictable cost when degrading.

olivia: thanks. from model-compat side we need explicit compatibility groups (quantized vs fp16) + token-limit differences. can't auto-fall back across incompatible output formats.

sam: customer asks: allow region fallback to nearest region within 100ms RTT, else route to cheaper variant in same region. add to acceptance criteria?

jessica: SRE: need circuit-breaker thresholds: error-rate > 3% for 2 min => stop routing to pool; also capacity-starved = fallback to lower-tier pool.

kevin (product-design): add user-visible signals: header in response like `x-fallback-reason` + telemetry event `fallback.trigger`.

maria: propose launch M1 (prod beta) scope: implement tiered fallback chain + compatibility matrix + basic metrics + header. Out-of-scope: proactive model warmup, predictive routing.

dan: dev notes: API config example:
```
fallback_chain:
  - primary: model=redwood-002, tier=gold
  - alt1: model=redwood-002-quant, tier=silver
  - alt2: model=open-7b, tier=bronze, region=eu
``` 
small validator should ensure alt's tokenizer & response shape match primary.

olivia: edge cases: 1) user locks model version (pin) => no cross-model fallback, only region/instance fallback. 2) streaming vs non-streaming mismatch => can't fallback.

sam: launch criteria checklist (suggested):
- config schema + API validation
- compat matrix published
- telemetry for each fallback step
- SLO dashboard + alert for fallback rate > 1%
- docs + samples

maria: timeline: PRD review by Wed, RFC merged by Fri, dev spike week after. Who volunteers for RFC writeup?

dan: i'll take RFC draft + impl checklist. olivia helps with compat tests.

olivia: +1. i'll add test harness cases for tokenization & kv-cache compatibility.

jessica: i'll draft SRE runbook snippets and alert thresholds.

maria: thanks. open questions: should fallback preserve per-customer routing policies (e.g., blacklist region)? my suggestion: yes — enforcement order: customer policy -> compatibility -> cost/latency heuristics.

kevin (product-design): agree. also UX: show clear 'degraded' state in console, and allow opt-out per-tenant.

sre-bot: Incident template created: /incidents/templates/fallback-degradation

maria: great. i'll assemble notes into PRD doc and ping channel when ready. any final blockers?

dan: none from me. starting RFC draft tomorrow.

olivia: none. will ping if compatibility matrix gets weird.

maria: closing — thanks everyone :rocket:
